transcript.text: Dr. Morgan, before you approve this, I need to raise a critical safety concern based on our spring pilot. My field notes from the pilot — which are still in the department folder and were not included in the draft proposal — show that the field sites can safely accommodate no more than 18 students, not 28. Additionally, every off-campus field activity requires two supervising adults, not one. The draft's enrollment cap of 28 and single-teacher supervision for field activities are both inconsistent with what we found during the pilot, and I'd recommend revising those specifications before final approval.

This needs to be corrected before the course launch specifications and catalog entry are approved.
